messages:
mike_a: Quick thread — ACME wants to run a 3-week POC, must use their own keys (BYO-KMS/HSM), and asked for pricing delta and rotation behavior. Can we confirm support and a rough quote?

jess_ciso: Hi team, they want assurance that keys never leave their HSM and rotations can be automated by their security team. Also need audit logs (KMS ops) forwarded to their SIEM.

sara_se: We support customer-managed keys for Redwood Private + Dedicated. Two flavors: cloud KMS-integrations (AWS/GCP/Azure) and HSM-backed BYO via key-wrapping/externally managed CMKs. For POC we usually do a KMS integration unless they insist on on-prem HSM.

raj_eng: Tech note: our runtime can accept envelope-wrapped keys and use a local key-encryption-key (KEK) flow. For native AWS KMS we use GenerateDataKey/Decrypt flow. For HSM (thales/azure ekm) we require a secure keywrap endpoint + mutual TLS.

mike_a: Timeline ask from customer: start next Monday. POC needs sample traffic (50 qps bursts) and rotation test. Any blockers for next-week spin-up?

raj_eng: If they use cloud KMS (AWS KMS) -> we can stand up Dedicated env in ~2 business days. If they bring an on-prem HSM we need network/firewall setup + cert exchange; plan for ~7-10 days.

lucy_salesops: Pricing: BYO-KMS/Customer-managed keys add a configuration fee + monthly operational surcharge when using Dedicated or Private. For short POC we can offer a capped pilot fee — suggest $X for first 3 weeks (I’ll DM exact numbers).

jess_ciso: Rotation policy detail: they want daily rotation for data-encryption keys and quarterly rotation for root KEKs. Can Redwood trigger rotation via API or must customer push?

raj_eng: We support both modes. Typically customer rotates master keys in their KMS and we re-wrap or fetch new DEKs on first use. We expose endpoints to trigger rekey/rotate and also can accept webhook notifications from their KMS for automatic handoffs.

mike_a: Security questionnaire item: they asked for key custody diagram and that keys are non-exportable from HSM. Who owns producing that asset?

sara_se: I can draft the key custody diagram + text stating our operations: in Private the CMK stays in customer KMS/HSM; Redwood only sees wrapped DEKs. For Dedicated (hosted in our infra) we can enable HSM-backed keys where the CMK is not exportable. I’ll attach an example.

deploy-bot: [deploy] Dedicated cluster for acme-poc scheduled: 1793456800 — status: pending approval :rocket:

mike_a: Thanks — next steps: Sara to produce custody diagram + integration checklist, Raj to confirm the mutual-TLS handshake specifics, Lucy to send pilot quote. I’ll loop in customer and schedule kickoff. :thumbsup:

jess_ciso: Perfect, please include SOC2 audit path and KMS access logs retention options in the follow-up.

sara_se: Will do. I’ll post the checklist in this thread by EOD today.
